silhouette.reason: Fur cards now cover the back, flanks, chest and tail, so the outline is shaggy and wild; but the back slopes steeply from high shoulders to low hips and the long narrow muzzle stays, so 3/4 REAR and SIDE read hyena/coyote more than grey wolf.
fixes: level the topline (raise the hips or lower the withers ~5 cm)

proportions.reason: 1.3 x 0.3 x 0.9 m fits the sourced box; chest deeper and ears smaller now, but the head is still small with a long thin snout and the forelegs thin under the heavy fur.
fixes: skull width ~0.55 of skull length with a shorter, deeper muzzle

materials.reason: Fur cards over flanks and shoulders now give a real coat read, agouti saddle over buff flanks and cream chest; pinkish-lilac streaks on the shoulder read as paint, not fur.
fixes: remove the pink tint from the shoulder streaks (grey-brown matting instead)

detail.reason: Hair-flow fur cards, chest ruff and cheek fringe, eyes with lids, nose, lip line, toes with claws.
fixes: brow tufts and a darker lip margin

wear.reason: Lower legs and paws are now dark with mud and the flank shows streaks; but the mud is an even dark sock with a hard line, and the streaks read as pink paint rather than matted fur or scars.
fixes: mud splashes graded up from the paws, heaviest at the toes
matted grey-brown flank streaks and a nick in one ear

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 (3.6k) keeps pose and a few back cards, but the coat turns a pale tan with no saddle, the legs are blocky tubes and the paws buns: a strong pop against the dark shaggy LOD0.
fixes: paint the agouti saddle and dark legs into LOD2 vertex colour
fur cards on flanks and tail at LOD2
8-sided legs and shaped paws at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS: 106.9k / 29.4k / 3.6k tris, 4 / 4 / 2 draws; LOD2 grew to 3.6k triangles while still popping.
fixes: adaptive cell size: finer on head and paws, coarser on flanks
spend LOD2 triangles on fur cards instead of flank tessellation
